from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); now_year, now_month=now.year, now.month
print('now', now_year, now_month)

expired_criteria=lambda exp_y, exp_m: (exp_y < now_year) or (exp_y==now_year and exp_m < now_month)

sup_cards=apis.supervisor.show_payment_cards()
# compute which supervisor cards are expired (for reference)
sup_exp=[c for c in sup_cards if expired_criteria(c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'])]
print('Supervisor expired cards:', [(c['card_name'], c['card_number'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month']) for c in sup_exp])

# apps to check
apps=['amazon','venmo','spotify']
app_tokens={'amazon':logins['amazon']['access_token'], 'venmo':logins['venmo']['access_token'], 'spotify':logins['spotify']['access_token']}

app_cards={}
for app in apps:
    token=app_tokens[app]
    # call show_payment_cards
    cards = apis.__getattr__(app).show_payment_cards(access_token=token)
    app_cards[app]=cards
    print(app, 'cards count', len(cards))
    # print cards summary
    for c in cards:
        print(' ', app, c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], int(c['card_number']), c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month'], 'expired?', expired_criteria(c['expiry_year'], int(c['expiry_month'])))

# build delete targets: expired cards in each app

delete_targets=[]
for app in apps:
    for c in app_cards[app]:
        exp_y=c['expiry_year']
        exp_m=int(c['expiry_month'])
        if expired_criteria(exp_y, exp_m):
            delete_targets.append({'app':app, 'payment_card_id':c['payment_card_id'], 'card_name':c['card_name'], 'card_number':int(c['card_number']), 'expiry_year':exp_y, 'expiry_month':exp_m})

print('TOTAL delete targets:', len(delete_targets))
# verification table
for t in delete_targets:
    print(t)

from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); now_year, now_month=now.year, now.month
print('Task:', 'Remove expired payment cards from all my app accounts that have payment cards.')
print('Now (year, month):', now_year, now_month)

# Criteria table
criteria=[]
criteria.append({
    'Criterion':'Expired payment card',
    'Exact Quote from Task':'Remove expired payment cards',
    'Implementation':'expiry_year < now_year OR (expiry_year == now_year AND expiry_month < now_month)'
})
criteria.append({
    'Criterion':'Applies to apps that have payment cards',
    'Exact Quote from Task':'all my app accounts that have payment cards',
    'Implementation':'Only apps with show_payment_cards + delete_payment_card endpoints and where show_payment_cards returns cards'
})
print('CRITERIA:', criteria)

# Credentials
pwds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
pwd_dict={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in pwds}
email='chris.mcco@gmail.com'

apps=['amazon','venmo','spotify']
# login
app_tokens={}
for app in apps:
    token_resp=apis.__getattr__(app).login(username=email, password=pwd_dict[app])
    app_tokens[app]=token_resp['access_token']
print('Logged in apps:', list(app_tokens.keys()))

# Fetch current cards per app
app_cards={}
for app in apps:
    cards=apis.__getattr__(app).show_payment_cards(access_token=app_tokens[app])
    app_cards[app]=cards
    print(app, 'total cards:', len(cards))
    print([(c['payment_card_id'], c['card_name'], c['expiry_year'], c['expiry_month']) for c in cards])

# Identify expired targets
expired_targets=[]
for app in apps:
    for c in app_cards[app]:
        exp_y=c['expiry_year']; exp_m=int(c['expiry_month'])
        is_expired = (exp_y < now_year) or (exp_y==now_year and exp_m < now_month)
        if is_expired:
            expired_targets.append({
                'app': app,
                'payment_card_id': c['payment_card_id'],
                'card_name': c['card_name'],
                'expiry_year': exp_y,
                'expiry_month': exp_m
            })

print('Target set (expired cards to delete):', len(expired_targets))
print(expired_targets)

# Validation: counts by app
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter([t['app'] for t in expired_targets])
print('Targets per app:', dict(cnt))

# Pre-completion: verify deletion results then complete task
from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); now_year, now_month=now.year, now.month
expired=lambda exp_y, exp_m: (exp_y < now_year) or (exp_y==now_year and exp_m < now_month)

pwds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); pwd_dict={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in pwds}
email='chris.mcco@gmail.com'
apps=['amazon','venmo','spotify']

app_tokens={}
for app in apps:
    app_tokens[app]=apis.__getattr__(app).login(username=email, password=pwd_dict[app])['access_token']

post_state={}
for app in apps:
    cards=apis.__getattr__(app).show_payment_cards(access_token=app_tokens[app])
    post_state[app]=cards
    ids=[c['payment_card_id'] for c in cards]
    exp_flags=[expired(c['expiry_year'], int(c['expiry_month'])) for c in cards]
    print(app,'remaining_cards',len(cards),'expired_count',sum(exp_flags),'ids',ids)

# Check that deleted ids 10 and 14 not present (from earlier targets)
for app in apps:
    ids=[c['payment_card_id'] for c in post_state[app]]
    print(app,'has_id_10',10 in ids,'has_id_14',14 in ids)

# List API endpoints explored/called (for sanity)
explored_called=[
    ('supervisor','show_payment_cards'),
    ('supervisor','show_account_passwords'),
    ('amazon','login'), ('amazon','show_payment_cards'), ('amazon','delete_payment_card'),
    ('venmo','login'), ('venmo','show_payment_cards'), ('venmo','delete_payment_card'),
    ('spotify','login'), ('spotify','show_payment_cards'), ('spotify','delete_payment_card'),
]
print('Explored/called:', explored_called)

# Complete task
complete_doc=apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='supervisor', api_name='complete_task')
print('complete_task doc parameters:', complete_doc.get('parameters', []))
param_names=[p['name'] for p in complete_doc.get('parameters', [])]
if not param_names:
    result=apis.supervisor.complete_task()
else:
    # pass no answer if answer optional
    if 'answer' in param_names:
        # if required, provide minimal value; if optional, still okay to omit but we can check constraints
        ans_param=[p for p in complete_doc['parameters'] if p['name']=='answer'][0]
        required=ans_param.get('required', False)
        if required:
            result=apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer='Removed expired payment cards')
        else:
            result=apis.supervisor.complete_task()
    else:
        # unknown params, safest: omit
        result=apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print('complete_task result:', result)
